attachAutoBody: The machine joins the subscription the token belongs to, and the services the subscription recommends are turned on.
attachBody: The machine joins the subscription the token belongs to. No service is turned on; turn on what you need below.
detachBody: The machine leaves the subscription and every Pro service is turned off.
detachNote: Leave the subscription; Pro services go off.
disableBody: pro turns the service off; what it installed may stay.
enableBody: pro turns the service on: it may install packages or a snap.
installBody: ubuntu-pro-client is installed from the machine's archive.
invalidToken: That does not look like a token from the Pro dashboard.
keywords: ubuntu pro subscription livepatch esm fips
noClient: The Ubuntu Pro client (pro) is not installed.
notAttached: Attach this machine to a subscription first.
notEntitled: The subscription does not cover that service.
notUbuntu: Ubuntu Pro attaches Ubuntu machines only.
progressHint: You can close this window; the agent carries on.
servicesNote: Services can be turned on once the machine is attached.
title: Ubuntu Pro
tokenHint: From ubuntu.com/pro/dashboard. Free for personal use on up to five machines.
